data.title: Seniority mix of software postings (Indeed Hiring Lab)
data.summary: Senior-level roles accounted for 69.3% of software development postings and entry-level roles for 4.5% in the first quarter of 2026, measured on one job board's postings rather than on all vacancies.
data.citation: Indeed Hiring Lab, The Labor Market Is Tilting Toward Seniority, 23 July 2026.
